input.quote: This Terminal Station Right of Use shall commence on the RFS Date and shall continue for the duration of this Agreement.
input.rationale:
The licence analogue here is the Terminal Station Right of Use in §11 (plus the capacity/IRU rights in §12). It is granted for the full duration of the Agreement (§11.1), carries no charges beyond Capital Costs and O&M (§11.2), extends to our IRU purchasers (§11.5), and is not revocable at the Terminal Parties' discretion — the only forfeiture route is reclamation of capacity under §23 for unpaid amounts after notice and a two-month cure period, i.e. uncured material breach. On scope/transfer, §22.3 and §22.4 let us assign our rights to a successor, Parent Company, Subsidiary or Affiliate (and another Affiliate of our Parent) without Management Committee consent, subject only to written notice to the other Parties under §22.6; third-party transfers need consent that must not be unreasonably withheld, and §12.20/§12.22 permit unrestricted IRU sales and commercial use by other Carriers after the stated trigger. That satisfies the fallback (affiliates on written notice; transferable to a successor) and largely reaches the preferred position. Sub-elements short of preferred, noted but not redlined: contractors acting on our behalf are not expressly named (though §17.3 contemplates shared/co-located Direct Access facilities for Carriers), and the right runs for the life of the Agreement rather than being expressed as perpetual and irrevocable, which is normal for a consortium cable system. No obligation here is adverse to us in a way that fails the fallback.</rationale>
